title: fraxinus willdenowiana
intro:
Fraxinus willdenowiana, commonly known as the prickly ash or Manchineel Ash, is a species of flowering plant in the olive family (Oleaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus willdenowiana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic effects, which have been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.

Note: The Manchineel Ash is actually known as Hura crepitans, not Fraxinus willdenowiana.
